items.source:
Removes and returns the top ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getDirection() element from lists stored at ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getKeys().
Blocks connection until element available or ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getTimeout() reached.
items.translation:
从存储在ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getKeys()的列表中移除并返回位于顶部（由ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getDirection()指定）的元素。
阻塞连接，直到有可用元素或达到ReactiveListCommands.BPopCommand.getTimeout()。

items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。
